name: lp-pratorapido
description: Landing page de vendas do Prato Rápido (React + TypeScript + styled-components) com servidor Node.js de integração (Cakto, acesso por e-mail).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c auto "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
